assumptions.statement: The current traffic volume to the MySQL databases is low enough to allow them to be grouped on a single instance without capacity issues.
assumptions.quote: Due to the low amount of traffic most of the MySQL databases receive we decided against this due to cost and the number of instances it would require.

assumptions.statement: The team has a significant existing investment in Puppet for managing database users and databases, making a switch to Terraform providers undesirable at this time.
assumptions.quote: we have a large, existing, investment in using puppet for these tasks

assumptions.statement: The centralization of databases is intended to be a temporary measure, as the signon application and database will be converted to PostgreSQL after the initial migration.
assumptions.quote: once the 'lift and shift' is done we will convert the signon application and database to PostgreSQL
